name:        useOverflow
domain:      hook

description: Measures children rendered in a hidden container to determine how many fit in the available width without flickering. Uses ResizeObserver to react to container and measured-child size changes. The measurement container should hold all items plus an optional overflow indicator element (identified by a data-overflow-indicator attribute).

name:        useScrollableArea
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Adds canonical axis-aware scroll behavior to structure owned by the caller. An axis is effective only when its computed overflow is scroll-capable and geometry exceeds the shared 1px tolerance. Both viewport and content boxes are observed.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useScrollableArea

name:        useScrollOverflow
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Tracks scroll overflow state for a horizontally scrollable container. Returns a ref callback and state booleans that update as the user scrolls, the container resizes, or its content changes (a child added, removed or resized, or a new gap or padding). Uses scroll event listeners, ResizeObserver and MutationObserver for reactive updates. Tolerance of 1px is applied to avoid sub-pixel false positives.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useScrollOverflow
